headlineEn: Canadian-built skate-stopper hardware engineered for our climate
headlineFr: Matériel bloque-skate fabriqué au Canada, conçu pour notre climat
bodyEn:
## What we do

We make and install **skate stoppers** — small metal studs, strips, and clamps that prevent skateboarding damage to ledges, handrails, benches, and architectural hardscape. Our hardware ships to and installs across **15 Canadian cities** and our extended service area, from coastal Halifax to Pacific Victoria.

## Why we exist

Most skate-stopper hardware sold in Canada is **imported US-spec product** that fails Canadian winter conditions. **304 stainless** rusts in 5 years on Vancouver and Halifax salt-air. **Standard concrete anchors** heave out of Edmonton's 2.1 m frost line. **Heritage-incompatible finishes** get rejected by conservation officers in Quebec City and Ottawa.

We build for the climate we live in. Every product line specifies the exact stainless grade, anchor depth, and finish that survives the **specific failure modes** of each Canadian region — coastal pitting, prairie freeze-thaw, heritage-conservation review.

## Who we work with

- **Transit authorities**: TTC, STM, OC Transpo, Calgary Transit, BC Transit, Edmonton Transit Service, Halifax Transit
- **Municipalities**: City of Toronto, Ville de Montréal, City of Vancouver, City of Calgary, Ottawa, Halifax Regional Municipality
- **Universities**: UBC, McGill, University of Toronto, McMaster, University of Calgary, Dalhousie
- **Federal heritage**: Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC) standing offer; Parks Canada coordination on Citadel Halifax, Parliament Hill, Quebec City fortifications
- **REIT and CRE**: Cadillac Fairview, Oxford Properties, RioCan, Brookfield Properties

## How we engineer for Canada

**By climate zone:** Frost-depth specs from **0.45 m (Victoria)** to **2.4 m (Winnipeg)**. **316L marine-grade stainless** mandatory for coastal cities. **Extended-shaft epoxy anchors** for deep-frost prairie installs. **Cold-weather rapid-cure epoxy** rated to **-15°C** for mid-winter installations.

**By heritage status:** Conservation-officer pre-approval workflow for federal, provincial, and municipal heritage sites. **Bronze patina** with artificial-aging process to match existing heritage hardware. Reversibility documentation showing zero substrate damage on extraction.

**By accessibility code:** Every install certified to **OBC, CNB, AODA / LAPHO** with the relevant code reference in every quote. Handrail stoppers placed outside the graspable zone. Bench studs flush within ±0.5 mm of seating surface.

## What you can expect

- **24-hour quote turnaround** with itemized hardware, install labour, and climate upgrade pricing
- **Free site-visit quotes** within our 15 priority cities (flat-rate $250 outside)
- **Lifetime corrosion warranty** on 316 marine-grade stainless
- **5-year install workmanship warranty** (7-year extension in deep-frost zones)
- **No surprise add-ons** — what's quoted is what's invoiced
bodyFr:
## Ce que nous faisons

Nous fabriquons et installons des **bloque-skate** — petits plots, bandes et serrages en métal qui empêchent les dégâts de skateboard aux rebords, mains courantes, bancs et hardscape architectural. Notre matériel est livré et installé dans **15 villes canadiennes** et notre zone de service étendue.

## Pourquoi nous existons

La plupart des bloque-skate vendus au Canada sont des **produits américains importés** qui échouent en conditions hivernales canadiennes. L'**inox 304** rouille en 5 ans sur l'air salin de Vancouver et Halifax. Les **ancres béton standards** sortent de la ligne de gel de 2,1 m d'Edmonton. Les **finitions incompatibles patrimoine** sont rejetées par les agents de conservation à Québec et Ottawa.

Nous construisons pour le climat dans lequel nous vivons.

## Avec qui nous travaillons

- **Autorités de transport** : TTC, STM, OC Transpo, Calgary Transit, BC Transit, Edmonton Transit Service, Halifax Transit
- **Municipalités** : Ville de Toronto, Ville de Montréal, Vancouver, Calgary, Ottawa, Halifax
- **Universités** : UBC, McGill, U of T, McMaster, Université Calgary, Dalhousie
- **Patrimoine fédéral** : Offre permanente SPAC ; Parcs Canada
- **FPI et immobilier commercial** : Cadillac Fairview, Oxford Properties, RioCan, Brookfield Properties

## Comment nous ingénions pour le Canada

Profondeurs de gel **0,45 m (Victoria)** à **2,4 m (Winnipeg)**. **Inox 316L grade marin** obligatoire pour les villes côtières. Conformité **CBC, CNB, LAPHO** dans chaque devis.

## Ce à quoi vous pouvez vous attendre

- **Devis en 24 heures** détaillé
- **Visites de site gratuites** dans nos 15 villes prioritaires
- **Garantie corrosion à vie** sur inox 316 grade marin
- **Garantie d'installation 5 ans** (extension 7 ans en zones de gel profond)
